text: At its meeting on February 7, 2022, the Budget Committee considered Item BU45.3 headed "Response to Ontario Regulation 286/09 Budget Matters - Expenses" and made recommendations to the Executive Committee. The Executive Committee will make recommendations on this Item to City Council for its consideration at its meeting on February 17, 2022. Summary from report (January 24, 2022) from the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer Ontario Regulation 286/09 "Budget Matters - Expenses" (Regulation) permits the City of Toronto (City) to exclude the following expenses from its annual budget: - amortization expenses; - post-employment benefits expenses; and - solid waste landfill closure and post-closure expenses.
